description: C Prolog is a Prolog interpreter written in C, based on the Prolog system written in IMP by Luis Damas for ICL 2900 computers. It implements standard Edinburgh Prolog with floating point arithmetic, a debugger, and various evaluable predicates.
name: C Prolog
license: Copyright (C) 1982 Fernando Pereira, Luis Damas and Lawrence Byrd
releaseNotes: Version 1.5 (20 Feb 1984): Extended manual, many bug fixes and improvements. The debugger has been almost entirely rewritten and now has the 'retry' command. Command line switches for working area sizes changed to lower-case. Checked under VMS, Eunice, and Berkeley Unix on VAXes and Suns. Identifiers changed to avoid name clashes with Version 7 or System III C compilers.
runtimePlatform: VMS, Eunice, Berkeley Unix (VAX, Sun workstation)

author.affiliation: EdCAAD, Dept. of Architecture, University of Edinburgh
